text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — PicaHealth (renewal due in ~6w) usage for the embedding and search routes dropped ~68% last 7d vs prior 7d. Quick triage?

Liam O'Connor: saw the grafana alert earlier. Seats still active but daily token volume collapsed. Any known change on their side? Proc team?

Priya Singh: Noted. Who is the new ML lead? Last contact was with Dan — has he left?

Maya Patel: Dan stepped down two weeks ago per account notes. New contact is Aisha Rahman (Head of Data) — joined 9 days ago. She hasn't been looped on onboarding. No POC activity.

Sergio Alvarez: I can pull query & logs. adding quick SQL to check usage by route: ```SELECT route, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM logs WHERE customer='picahealth' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY route;```

OnboardingBot: Reminder — PicaHealth onboarding checklist: 7/10 completed, 'Advanced embeddings tuning' pending.

Liam O'Connor: Also saw a procurement RFP from a competitor (NoteAI) in their doc repo. Link: https://files.picahealth.com/RFP_Q1.pdf (redacted) Could be procurement-driven.

Priya Singh: Can we run a quick quality check on their top 5 prompts? If NoteAI produces cheaper embeddings they might be testing cost.

Maya Patel: Priya can you own quality check? Sergio — need usage split & KV cache hit rate. Liam — will reach out to Aisha to re-introduce Redwood + offer a short health sync. I'll propose Wed 10am PT.

Sergio Alvarez: Done. KV cache hit rate over last week = 12% (very low). Streaming latencies normal. Sending CSV to #cs-docs.

Liam O'Connor: DM sent to Aisha + calendar invite. Included 'cost comparison, quick eval help, action items'.

Priya Singh: Ran eval on 5 prompts — embedding cosine similarity drift small (avg 0.02), but semantic rerank failures on one template. I'll draft a mini playbook to improve ranking and suggest quantization profiles to save cost.

Maya Patel: Great. Plan: 1) Health sync Wed 10am PT (Liam lead) 2) Priya to share playbook before call 3) Sergio to prepare route-level metrics + cache tuning recs 4) Offer a 1-week free dedicated inference trial (50% off) to demonstrate perf/cost. Anyone object?

Sergio Alvarez: No objections. I'll include an A/B config suggestion for prefix caching.

Liam O'Connor: If they engage, sales can propose a short Dedicated trial with SLA. I'll loop AM.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. tagging @here — moving to action items. :white_check_mark:
